title: Disneyland, Disney World and Gene Traxler
summary: Coquille tells of visiting Disneyland with Liberto and missing Don Lamont and Gene Traxler at Disney World.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Oh, pretty good. He had some great musicians with him. I went to Disney World in Orlando, Florida. Well, I went to Disneyland when I was working in Las Vegas. On our day off, Roy LaBord and I went over to Disneyland in Anaheim, California. We spent nine hours in Disneyland and really enjoyed it. And I said to myself, well, I've got to get the wife and kids to Disney World so they can see this, because this is fantastic. And when I went to Disney World, oh, many years later, because Disney World was built up many years later. And of course, it's beautiful and I think it's larger even geographically in size than Anaheim, California. But anyway, after I got back home from Disney World, I found out that these musicians that I really wanted to see were up on top of the contemporary hotel roof. Like Don Lamont, famous drummer. Oh.
And Arthur Godfrey's old bass player was up there that used to do that radio show. And I can't recall his name. Traxler?
